newsitem.title: USA: US cash crude outrights slip, fundamental concerns.
newsitem.headline: US cash crude outrights slip, fundamental concerns.

text.p: U.S. cash crude prices slid lower for outright crude benchmarks, while most grades marked time in a sluggish Friday session, traders said.
Domestic barrels edged to firmer differentials for Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James, while sour grades slid slightly.

June West Texas Intermediate/Cushing lost 30 cents to talk late at $19.55-65 a barrel. July WTI/Cushing gained against front month June barrels, pushing cash outrights further into contango. Usually markets rest in a state of backwardation, with nearest months holding a premium to the later months, but contango occurs when bearish sentiment deflates the near month.
